summary: Half-ton Chevy pickup lost 4-wheel drive near Idaho Springs, winched with two vehicles, then pulled with a strap up a long steep loose hill to regain traction
notes: Date: report posted 2017-06-21 (Wednesday) says mission was "Monday" -> 2017-06-19. Second call of a double-header recovery day, same Idaho Springs area as the sideways Jeep (separate row). Occupant count unstated; report uses plural "them".
